Frequently asked questions

Which regulations do these courses follow?
  • Back Safety and Injury Prevention Training: in accordance with Federal OSHA and NIOSH Guidelines and the OSHA General Duty Clause.
  • OSHA Noise Exposure and Hearing Conservation Training: in accordance with Federal OSHA Regulations 29 CFR 1926.52 and 29 CFR 1910.95.
  • Ergonomics Safety Training: in accordance with Federal OSHA and NIOSH Guidelines.
  • OSHA Compressed Gas Cylinder Safety Training: in accordance with Federal OSHA Standards 29 CFR 1910.101 and 29 CFR 1926.350.
  • OSHA Machine Guarding Safety Training: in accordance with Federal OSHA Regulation 29 CFR 1910 Subpart O.
  • OSHA Warehouse Safety Training: in accordance with Federal OSHA Regulations 29 CFR 1910 for General Industry and OSHA’s General Duty Clause.
How long does Warehouse Safety, Machine Guarding & Ergonomics Training take?
  • Back Safety and Injury Prevention Training: 1 hour.
  • OSHA Noise Exposure and Hearing Conservation Training: 1 hour.
  • Ergonomics Safety Training: 2 hours.
  • OSHA Compressed Gas Cylinder Safety Training: 2 hours.
  • OSHA Machine Guarding Safety Training: 2 hours.
  • OSHA Warehouse Safety Training: 14 hours.

Training is self-paced, so you can stop and pick up where you left off at any time.

How long do I have to finish?

You get a 3-month completion timeline, 1-year access to training materials.

Do I get a certificate?

Yes. You can download your certificate of completion as soon as you pass the final exam.

  • Back Safety and Injury Prevention Training: valid 36 months
  • OSHA Noise Exposure and Hearing Conservation Training: valid 12 months
  • Ergonomics Safety Training: valid 36 months
  • OSHA Compressed Gas Cylinder Safety Training: valid 36 months
  • OSHA Machine Guarding Safety Training: valid 36 months
  • OSHA Warehouse Safety Training: valid 12 months
Can I take the training on my phone?

Yes. The training is 100% online and works on phones, tablets and computers, 24 hours a day.

Can I buy training for my whole team?

Yes. Enter the number of seats at checkout. Team pricing starts at 2 seats and goes up to 10% off for 501–1,000 seats. For larger orders or invoicing, call 1‑866‑429‑6742.

Is the training available in Spanish?

These courses are available in English and Spanish:

  • Back Safety and Injury Prevention Training
  • OSHA Noise Exposure and Hearing Conservation Training
  • Ergonomics Safety Training
  • OSHA Compressed Gas Cylinder Safety Training
  • OSHA Machine Guarding Safety Training

The other course is in English.

How do I start my course after I pay?

Right after checkout you'll get an email with your receipt and your login for the learning portal. Sign in at hazwoper-osha.com to begin.

Who provides the training?

Courses are delivered by HAZWOPER OSHA Training, LLC on its online learning portal at hazwoper-osha.com. Questions? Call 1‑866‑429‑6742.

What is the refund policy?

See the refund policy on hazwoper-osha.com, or call us before you start a course.
